email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoZanix patient with mild nausea

[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a clinical care coordinator at Fictional Community Clinic (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 34-year-old male patient with a history of generalized anxiety disorder received their third dose of DemoZanix (dose: 5mg) via oral.
Treatment started on 2026-01-26.
Approximately 7 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed mild nausea.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
M. Reyes (fictional reporter)
Fictional Community Clinic
